name: text-scroll-animation
blurb: Full-page scroll sequence with text animations staggered by word, letter, or line.
description: Wrapper component using Framer Motion's whileInView to reveal text sections as they scroll into view. Supports per-word, per-letter, or per-line animations with configurable direction and blur effects.
use_when: Long-form landing pages or narrative sections where text should animate in gradually as users scroll.
avoid_when: Mobile with scroll-jacking; performance-sensitive sites with many instances.
a11y: Text fully rendered in the DOM; animations triggered by scroll intersection, does not respond to prefers-reduced-motion.
